Name: More Wild Berries for 1.6
Author: MelindaC
Description:
[size=4]Overview:[/size]

"More Wild Berries for 1.6" is a mod that allows you to forage for boysenberries, marionberries and wild blueberries from bushes thanks to Bush Bloom Mod. This is the updated version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15963]"More Wild Berries"[/url] with a few changes:


Json Assets is no longer required. 
Artisanal Soda Makers is no longer be required.
Better Artisan Goods Icons will no longer be required (I added context tags for jellies and wines and let the game coding do the rest).

While doing research for Fizzy Drinks, I sometimes came across items that would fit the mod but didn't have the mechanics or modding capabilities to implement. Bush berries were one of them. Thanks to Bush Bloom Mod and its configurative options this is now possible.

For info on the berries: 

Boysenberries, a cross between a raspberry and a blackberry and mostly found wild in southern California, is available for picking in late spring and early summer. It is mostly used as preserves though a boysenberry soda is also available. This mod has the boysenberries available in Spring 25-28.

The Marionberry, a type of blackberry, were developed in the 1950s from a natural breeding program and mostly found wild in Oregon. It's a summer berry. It is mostly used in preserves and sodas. This mod has the marionberry season in Summer 23-27.

The Wild Blueberry is the wild cousin of the cultivated highbush variety but is smaller, sweeter and more nutritious. High in fibre and antioxidants, the wild blueberry played an important role in eastern Canada particularly Nova Scotia- the vast majority of frozen wild blueberries you may find in stores come from this province or Quebec. Unlike the other two berries, the wild blueberry has never been cultivated and is used in many different forms from preserves to syrups and drinks and much more. The wild blueberry season is from late summer to early fall. This mod has the wild blueberry available in Fall 2-6.

To see what the bushes and items look like, please check out the Images section.

[size=4][b][u]Requirements:

[/u][/b][/size]You are required to install the following:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[size=4][b][u]Installation:

[/u][/b][/size]-First make sure you have all the required mods and that they are up-to-date.
-Download the mod and extract the folders and place them in the Mods folder.
-If you installed the entire mod pack into the Mods folder, delete it after extracting the pack folders. That's it!

[size=4][b][u]Compatibilities:

[/u][/b][/size]-More Wild Berries for 1.6 are compatible with other BBM mods such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23859]Huckleberry Season for Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25042]CP Summer Berries[/url]. Other mods may affect availability at certain times but should still work.
-Mods that affect bush foraging such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7736]Auto Forager[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5108]Custom Tracker[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20799]Deluxe Grabber Redux 1.6[/url] . Make sure that the berry picking options are turned on if you want to make berry foraging easier.
-There should be no conflict with any other mods but let me know if there is.

[size=4][b][u]Troubleshooting:

[/u][/b][/size]-First make sure that you have all the required mods and that they are up to date.
-If using a retexture mod such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url], make sure that all bush properties including tilesheets are turned OFF as the berries will not appear.
-This is not compatible for Android or any other platform that still uses 1.5. The original mod is still available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15963]here[/url] if you want to try it but since I no longer have 1.5 I can't guarantee that I may be able to help you on any issues.
-If you have any issues related to this mod, please let me know. Any issues involving other mods should be directed to the author or official Stardew Valley or Nexus Stardew Valley forums.

[size=4][b][u]Uninstallation:
[/u][/b][/size]
-Make sure you have gotten rid of all items from this mod or the game may crash.
-Delete the BBM and CP folders from the Mods folder. That's it!

[size=4][b]Happy Berry Picking!

[/b][/size]
